Showers and thunderstorms associated with a low pressure system  located about 900 miles south of the southern tip of the Baja  California peninsula are showing better signs of organization.  Recent satellite-derived wind data indicate that this system is  already producing winds of tropical-storm-force. If current trends  continue, advisories will be initiated on a tropical storm this  afternoon. This system is forecast to move generally northwestward  at 10 to 15 mph for the next several days, staying well offshore of  the coast of Mexico. For additional information on this system,  including Gale Warnings, please see the High Seas Forecast issued  by the National Weather Service.  
 Formation chance through 48 hours...high...near 100 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...near 100 percent.

An area of low pressure is forecast to form this weekend well to the  south of southwestern Mexico. Environmental conditions appear  favorable for gradual development of this system, and a tropical  depression is likely to form early next week while it moves  west-northwestward to northwestward at 10 to 15 mph.  
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...80 percent.

Showers and thunderstorms associated with a low pressure area  located well east-southeast of the Hawaiian Islands have continued  to become better organized. Environmental conditions appear  conducive for continued development, and a tropical depression is  likely to form within the next day or so while the system drifts to  the northeast, before turning westward this weekend. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...high...80 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...90 percent.

An area of low pressure could form well south or southwest of the  Hawaiian Islands over the weekend or early next week. Some gradual  development is possible thereafter while the system moves slowly  west-northwestward, well offshore of the Hawaiian Islands. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...low...20 percent.
